purpose: Shared automatic keyword extraction governance for dated corpora. ERA is applied later from the current LOC_ERA_REGISTRY date boundaries.
rules: Prefer existing semantic_keywords/keywords/tags when present; otherwise extract deterministic CJK 2-4 grams and Latin words from text.
Count document frequency separately from total hit count.
Store source/date independently from ERA. ERA aggregation must use the latest LOC_ERA_REGISTRY boundaries at query time.
Do not hard-code Top 10 terms or ERA results.
